verses.1: And after Jesus left the temple, his disciples came to him and asked him to show them how to build the temple.
verses.2: And the one who replied said to them, “Don’t you see all this? Yes, I tell you, no stone will remain upon another stone that cannot be displaced.”
verses.3: While he was sitting there on the hillside of the olive trees, his disciples came up to him and said to him privately: “When will this happen? And what is the sign of the appearance and conclusion of the summer season?”
verses.4: And when Jesus spoke, he said to them, “See that none of you is led astray.”
verses.5: Many indeed will come to me, saying, “I am the Christ.” Then many will be led astray.
verses.6: Instead, you should listen to the sounds of war and its noise. Be aware that do not be frightened. For it must happen, but yet it remains to be the end.
verses.7: For nations will rise against one another, and kingdoms against each other. There will be floods and earthquakes in various places.
verses.8: But always, all these things are considered as starting points.
verses.9: Then they will put you into suffering and destroy you. And you will be hated by all nations because of my name.
verses.10: And at that time, many will become enemies and betray each other. They will also hate one another.
verses.11: And many false prophets will rise up and deceive many people.
verses.12: And because of the spread of this immorality, the love of many people will be destroyed.
verses.13: But he who remains until the end will be saved.
verses.14: And this gospel of the kingdom will be proclaimed throughout all the world, as a testimony to all nations. And then, its end will come.
verses.15: When you see the desolation caused by Daniel’s prophecy, in that holy place, it is a sign that one should reflect upon it.
verses.16: Then those who were in Judea fled to the mountains.
verses.17: The person who lives in that house does not take any clothes from his own home.
verses.18: And do not return back from that field, for its edge is too sharp for you to cross it.
verses.19: And you will also hear those sounds in your stomachs, and during those days when you are breastfeeding.
verses.20: Pray, then, that your flight will not take place in winter or on Sabbath days.
verses.21: For then, great suffering will be caused; such suffering has never happened since the beginning of the world up to now. It will certainly not happen either in the future.
verses.22: And even if those days weren’t subjected to punishment, not all suffering would be eliminated. But it is because of those chosen ones that those days will be subjected to punishment.
verses.23: Then, if anyone says to you, “Look, this is the Christ!” Do not believe him.
verses.24: For the false believers and deceivers will rise up, and they will give great signs and wonders, so that they may deceive even those who are chosen by God.
verses.25: I have recommended you to you.
verses.26: If they say this to you, then know that they are lying. You see, they’re in the desert; you can’t get out of there. And also, don’t believe them when they say they have money in their coffers.
verses.27: For just as the star rises from the east and appears until sunset, so too will the presence of the Son of Man be.
verses.28: Wherever there is a flight, there will also be gatherings of those who are together.
verses.29: But immediately after those days of suffering, the sun will darken, and the moon will not give any light. The stars will fall from the sky, and the forces of heaven will be destroyed.
verses.30: And then, the sign of the Son of Man will be seen in the heavens. Then, all the tribes of the earth will be destroyed, and the Son of Man will come down from the heavens with great power and glory.
verses.31: And he sends his messengers with a loud trumpet; and they will gather together those whom he has chosen from among the four winds that blow from the ends of heaven down to their ends.
verses.32: From the vine, you can understand the meaning of the parable. When its branches become thin and the leaves begin to sprout, then you know that it’s time for harvest.
verses.33: Similarly, when you see all these things, you must realize that it’s very close to the gates.
verses.34: I truly tell you that this situation will not end until all of these things actually happen.
verses.35: The sky and the earth will be destroyed, but my words will not be lost.
verses.36: And about that day and hour, no one knew anything; not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son himself. Only the Father alone knew.
verses.37: For just as the days of the world will end, so too will the presence of the Son of Man.
verses.38: For in those days, before the destruction came, people ate and drank, married and were married to others. It was until one day that Noe entered the ark.
verses.39: And they did not know until the time came when the deception happened and it affected everyone. In the same way, the appearance of the Son of Man will also be such.
verses.40: Then two will be left in the field. One will be taken away, and one will remain.
verses.41: Two truths are contained within that wheel: one is taken away, and one remains.
verses.42: So, hurry up, for you do not know which day your Lord will come.
verses.43: And you can see that if the landlord knows that the thief has entered his house, he will surely not allow him to continue living there.
verses.44: Therefore, you should be prepared for the time when the Son of Man will come. It doesn’t seem like that will happen anytime soon.
verses.45: So, what kind of faithful and careful servant is he, who was given by his master to endure hardships, so that he could provide food for them on time?
verses.46: The slave was so good that when his master came to find him, he would do things in such a manner.
verses.47: I say to you that he will be made equal to all those who exist in him.
verses.48: But if that evil slave says this in his heart… Then my Lord will decide for me.
verses.49: And he begins to torture his slaves. He also eats and drinks along with those who drink.
verses.50: The master of that slave will come to him one day, neither expecting it in advance nor knowing about it at all.
verses.51: And it will be divided into two parts, along with those who are pretending to be others. There, there will be pain and suffering for those who act in such a way.
